## Vantage 1.3 — sharper, lighter

**Website:** https://vantage-wallpapers.vercel.app

### Downloads
| Platform | File |
|:--|:--|
| macOS · Apple Silicon (M1–M5) | `Vantage-1.3.0-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS · Intel | `Vantage-1.3.0-x64.dmg` |
| Windows 10/11 · x64 | `Vantage-Setup-1.3.0-x64.exe` |
| Windows 11 · ARM | `Vantage-Setup-1.3.0-arm64.exe` |

### New
- **2K & 4K only:** the library now contains only wallpapers at least 1440 px on both edges — 7,300+ sharp wallpapers.
- **New bundled 4K wallpapers:** *Lu Guang × Cheng Xiaoshi (Link Click)* and *Raphtalia — The Rising of the Shield Hero*, available offline.
- **Save first frame:** turn any 2K/4K video into a full-quality still wallpaper; stills share a lightweight thumbnail and can be deleted and restored.
- **Lighter:** video dimensions and thumbnails are read with Electron itself instead of external tools.

### Changed
- 1080p and 720×1280 vertical wallpapers are no longer listed (below the new quality floor), so the Vertical section is hidden until 2K+ vertical wallpapers are added.

### First launch
- **Mac:** not notarized yet — if macOS can't verify the app, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.
- **Windows:** not code-signed yet — on SmartScreen choose **More info → Run anyway**.

Tested as a fresh install on clean macOS and Windows machines before release.
